ours-scaling.short: Night School's shelf of small models, trained for this film
ours-scaling.citation: media/school/scaling/facts.json, written by tools/school/fill_scaling.mjs from system/school/scaling.mjs: 12 models (width 8 to 64, depth 1 to 3) trained 4,000 steps on the same text, scored by held-out loss above the generator's floor; fits on log-log axes; the frontier over compute; three seeds at two grid points.
claims: Seed spread of log10 excess: 0.13761 (d16 L2), 0.11772 (d32 L2).
Frontier slope of excess against compute: -0.64767 (R2 0.97109); best size against budget slope 0.41372.
ours-scaling.n: 12 grid runs, one seed each, plus two extra seeds at two points.
ours-scaling.does_not_prove: The papers' exponents; one learning rate and schedule for every size is a confound.

kaplan2020.short: Kaplan and others 2020, Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
kaplan2020.citation: Kaplan, J., McCandlish, S., Henighan, T., Brown, T. B., Chess, B., Child, R., Gray, S., Radford, A., Wu, J., Amodei, D. (2020). Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models. arXiv:2001.08361.
kaplan2020.read: read by the core sub-agent; to be re-read by the fact-check
claims: Loss falls as a power law in non-embedding parameters, data and compute over about 768 to 1.5e9 parameters and several orders of magnitude of compute.

hoffmann2022.short: Hoffmann and others 2022, Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models (Chinchilla)
hoffmann2022.citation: Hoffmann, J., Borgeaud, S., Mensch, A., and others (2022). Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models. arXiv:2203.15556.
hoffmann2022.read: read by the core sub-agent; to be re-read by the fact-check
claims: Parameters and training tokens should grow in equal proportion with compute; many large models of the time were undertrained; Chinchilla (70B parameters, 1.4T tokens) outperforms Gopher (280B, 300B tokens) at the same compute.

factcheck: Independent fact-check 2026-10-15 (FACTCHECK.md): 21 correct, 9 reword, 0 wrong. Applied: look-back words named; 99.6 not rounded to 100; the one-floor 32 outlier excepted; the lesson's recipe at twice the length; the slope fits the gap above the floor; the best size grows mostly, not at every step; the closing claim about real text removed; the place table named; 'no brighter'.
